payload.title: Something Old Something New Meaning and Origins
payload.excerpt: Something old, something new, something borrowed, something blue: the rhyme as first recorded in 1883, the sixpence line, what each item means, and how to choose and carry heirlooms safely to a wedding overseas.
key_takeaways: The rhyme was first recorded in 1883, as the saying of "some Lancashire friends", and the sixpence line appears in print with it by 1946.
Something borrowed is lucky when a happily married bride has already worn it, and blue has long been linked with loyalty and true love.
Something old and something new are your own choice: many couples choose a family heirloom and a piece made or bought for the wedding.
Carry heirlooms, borrowed pieces and the sixpence in your hand luggage, photograph them before you fly, and check your travel insurance's per-item limits.

faq.q: What does something old, something new, something borrowed, something blue mean?
faq.a: Something borrowed is lucky when it has been worn by a happily married bride. Blue stands for loyalty and true love. Something old and something new are personal choices: many couples pick a family heirloom and a piece made or bought for the wedding.

faq.q: Who gives the bride something old, something new, something borrowed and something blue?
faq.a: Anyone close to the couple. Parents and grandparents often give something old or something new, a married sister or friend lends something borrowed, and many couples choose the blue themselves.
In the left shoe. Many couples tape it inside the shoe or tuck it under the insole so it is comfortable all day.
A mother, grandmother, sister or close friend is the usual choice, and the piece goes back after the wedding.

faq.q: Can the groom carry something old, new, borrowed or blue?
faq.a: Yes. Heirloom cufflinks, a borrowed tie pin, a new watch or blue initials stitched into a jacket lining all count.
Anything blue you wear or carry. A blue garter is the classic choice, and a sapphire, blue stitching, a ribbon on the bouquet or blue shoe soles all work.
